input.story: I bought a washing machine for 28000 in January 2024 and it stopped working in February 2024. The company never fixed it despite many calls. Can I file a consumer case now?

output.masked_story: I bought a washing machine for 28000 in January 2024 and it stopped working in February 2024. The company never fixed it despite many calls. Can I file a consumer case now?

case.problem_subtype: defective appliance and lack of service
case.summary: The user purchased a washing machine for 28000 in January 2024, which stopped working a month later in February 2024. Despite multiple calls, the company failed to repair or resolve the issue.
case.user_goal: File a consumer case to get a resolution or refund

timeline.event: Washing machine stopped working and customer service was contacted multiple times without resolution

evidence_missing: service request numbers or call logs
follow_up_questions: Which Indian state are you located in?
Do you have the purchase invoice and warranty card for the washing machine?
Do you have any written records, complaint numbers, or emails of your communication with the company?

flags.message: The problem started about 2.9 years ago. The usual time limit for this kind of claim is around 2 years - it may be expired or about to expire. See a lawyer quickly.

notes: A Consumer Commission can also award compensation and litigation costs - we don't estimate that figure; it depends on the case.
Interest on delayed money may be claimable; the rate is for a lawyer/court to decide, so we don't add it here.

assessment.where_you_stand: You purchased a defective washing machine for Rs 28,000 in January 2024 and faced a lack of service since February 2024 [KB:cpa_consumer_def]. Because the issue started nearly 2.9 years ago, you are past the standard 2-year time limit to file a consumer complaint [KB:cpa_limitation], which is a significant weakness unless you can show a good reason for the delay. However, you can still attempt to resolve this or consult a professional because the rule engine notes the time limit has passed. Since the claim value is up to Rs 5 lakh, the District Commission filing fee is nil and no lawyer is compulsory if you proceed [KB:cpa_fee_nil_5lakh], but given the delay, legal advice is strongly recommended.

options.title: Contact National Consumer Helpline [KB:forum_nch]
options.what_to_do: File a pre-litigation complaint at consumerhelpline.gov.in or call 1915 to see if the company responds.

options.title: File a complaint on e-Jagriti [KB:forum_ejagriti] portal
options.what_to_do: File a formal consumer complaint online on the e-Jagriti portal if informal steps fail, keeping in mind the delay issue [KB:forum_ejagriti].

proof_tips: Search your email, SMS, or bank statements to find the digital purchase invoice or payment receipt.
Gather any call logs, WhatsApp chats, or service request numbers showing you contacted the company.
what_i_dont_know: Whether the consumer commission will accept the delay beyond the standard 2-year period.
If you have valid written proof of your purchase and complaints.
assessment.needs_lawyer_reason: The problem started about 2.9 years ago, which exceeds the standard 2-year time limit for consumer complaints [KB:cpa_limitation], meaning you need a lawyer to see if an exception or condonation of delay can be filed.
assessment.reply: You purchased a washing machine in January 2024 that broke down immediately, and the company failed to repair it [KB:cpa_consumer_def]. However, because this happened nearly 2.9 years ago, you are past the normal 2-year time limit to file a consumer complaint [KB:cpa_limitation]. A consumer commission may reject a late complaint unless you have a very good reason for the delay. For claims under Rs 5 lakh, the filing fee is nil and you can file yourself [KB:cpa_fee_nil_5lakh], but given the time elapsed, consulting a lawyer is important to check if your delay can be condoned. You can also try free pre-litigation help through the National Consumer Helpline [KB:forum_nch]. Do you have any records or purchase invoices from January 2024 to prove when you bought the machine?
